tasks.title: Disabled and hidden fields
tasks.statement: Build a form with one labelled text input, one disabled input showing `locked` and one hidden field named `source`.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Field states</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/save" method="post">
    <label for="name">Name</label>
    <input id="name" name="name" type="text">
    <input name="code" value="locked" disabled>
    <input type="hidden" name="source" value="lesson">
    <button type="submit">Save</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected:
Name [____________]
locked
Save
